messages.author: 08f793518a16e98e
messages.subject: RApache config problem
parts:
My sysadmin installed RApache for me on our 64 bit Solaris box. I can
access the RApacheInfo page here (http://ri.imb.nrc.ca/zbroom/test/),
indicating that the module was successfully installed.

There is the following entry in the httpd.conf:

<Directory /websites/zbroom>
SetHandler r-script
RHandler brew::brew
</Directory>

which should require all files in the directory to be parsed through
the brew function of the brew package. As can be seen on my test page
(http://ri.imb.nrc.ca/zbroom/Rtest), the R code is ignored. There are
no errors thrown (nothing in the Apache logs).

This is the test code:

<html><head><title>R test</title></head>
<body>
<p>here is some normal text</p>

<%=rnorm(100); %>
<% print(rnorm(100)); %>

<p>Between this text and the first text there should be some R
output.</p>
</body>
</html>

What do I need to change so that the R code will be evaluated and
printed?

Thanks,
Jen

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: RApache config problem
parts:
I just tested this on my server, and you have a syntax error adding
the semi-colon after rnorm(100), but that's not what's causing your
error. Are you sure you sysadmin restarted the apache server? The
Directory stanza looks fine to me.

Jeff
